title: GeoSelect: Spatial-Program Execution for Training-Free Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2607.03869v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Referring remote sensing image segmentation segments the object named by a natural-language expression in an aerial image. Existing training-free methods resolve the expression through implicit vision-language activations or region-text similarity, which gives weak control over the spatial, superlative, and ordinal relations that dominate aerial referring, such as the rightmost ship or the second court from the left. We propose GeoSelect, a training-free pipeline that reframes referring as the execution of a typed spatial program. A frozen, text-only language model synthesises the expression into a small domain-specific language, a well-formedness checker accepts the program, and a deterministic executor runs it. The central abstraction is a single scored candidate set type under which every operator composes: continuous geometric fields realise position and proximity, while discrete set and order operators add the extremum, or

translated_title: GeoSelect：基于空间程序执行的无训练指代遥感图像分割
translated_abstract: 指代遥感图像分割旨在根据自然语言表达在航空影像中分割出所指的对象。现有的无训练方法通过隐式的视觉-语言激活或区域-文本相似度来解析表达，这对航空指代任务中占主导地位的空间、最高级和序数关系（例如“最右边的船”或“左边第二个球场”）的控制能力较弱。我们提出GeoSelect，一种将指代重新构建为类型化空间程序执行的无训练流水线。一个冻结的纯文本语言模型将表达合成为一个小型领域特定语言，由格式良好性检查器验证该程序，再由确定性执行器运行它。其核心抽象是一个单一的评分候选集类型，所有算子均在该类型下组合：连续几何场实现位置与邻近关系，而离散集合与顺序算子则添加极值或（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GeoSelect将指代遥感图像分割重新构建为类型化空间程序的确定性执行，利用冻结的纯文本语言模型将表达合成为领域特定语言，通过连续几何场与离散集合/顺序算子的组合，在无需训练的情况下精确处理空间、最高级和序数关系。
en_tdlr: GeoSelect reframes referring remote sensing image segmentation as the deterministic execution of typed spatial programs synthesized by a frozen text-only language model, composing continuous geometric fields with discrete set and order operators to precisely handle spatial, superlative, and ordinal relations in a training-free manner.
